description: This file defines the 'Nodes' class in the Twig templating engine, representing a list of node objects in the Abstract Syntax Tree (AST). It includes metadata such as author and attributes.

classes.name: Nodes
classes.description: Represents a list of nodes in the Twig AST, extending the base Node class with default constructor.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Nodes object with an optional array of nodes and a line number.
